summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its first-quarter 2026 earnings press release. The release details financial results showing Robotaxi revenue growth of 395.4% year-over-year and an increase in fleet targets. No special-situation corporate event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change—is announced. This is a routine earnings report filed by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
